claims.value: Photograph (colour); view of petroglyphs of the bird-man on rocks, on top of a cliff, with the sea in the background; Orongo, Easter Island.

notes.text: This British Museum catalogue record describes a photograph by Katesa Schlosser, made in September 1980. It is registered as a documentary source, not as a physical Rapa Nui artefact. The 30 September 2026 image-rights review found that the museum's image page explicitly says the image is unavailable for download and supplies no reusable image licence or credit, so no image is published. Only the complete Description field is extracted; the record identifies the view as Orongo but does not identify individual carvings.

captures.note: Image 512397001 page identifies the depicted place but reports that the image is unavailable for download and supplies no reusable image licence or credit.
